occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation did not have a completed drill log.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home: There was 9 children in care upon inspection. Ages 6m,12m,13m,23m,2y,2y,3y,6y,9y. occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)
